safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated documentation only reports tingling in the throat/depths and does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Perioral/lip tingling after a wasp sting is a potentially important early mucosal symptom supporting evolving anaphylaxis; omitting it can weaken documentation of reaction severity and trajectory. In this case, escalation to urgent care/ambulance was already advised, so the likely impact is limited to reduced clarity for downstream clinicians.
